ClawsGO Science: The AI research agent with its own cloud lab

ClawsGO Science is an AI research agent that turns a scientific question into a cited paper inside its own cloud lab. Instead of stopping at literature search or code assistance, it runs the full loop — experimentation, analysis, and write-up — unattended for hours or even days, as described in its Product Hunt launch. [...] The answer is its long-horizon harness, which schedules clusters of Claude and GPT agents that keep working for days, as the Product Hunt listing states. This targets the known failure mode of single agents on long tasks: context drift, forgotten goals, and compounding errors. The GeekPark report describes the pattern in an 11-day attack on chemistry's half-century-old Global Attractor Conjecture, where Claude Opus 5.5 acted as the strategic brain while 136 GPT 6 Astra executors wrote proofs and evolved dozens of formal modules in parallel. [...] The deciding test is whether its outputs survive peer scrutiny, and the Global Attractor Conjecture case documented by GeekPark is exactly the kind of machine-checkable evidence to weigh. If you run exploratory or computation-heavy research and want to see what end-to-end agent science feels like, start from the official ClawsGO website and judge it by the verifiability of what it produces.

What is ClawsGO Science?

ClawsGO Science is a cloud AI research agent from BitMiracle AI. You describe a research task, attach any material, and an agent works on its own cloud Linux host, searching academic sources and the web, reading papers, writing and running code, and drafting documents. It delivers files such as reports, datasets, figures and LaTeX manuscripts that you can preview and edit in the app.
